keyEvents.text: Goal! Lens 0, Marseille 1. Amine Gouiri (Marseille) right footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal.
Goal! Lens 1, Marseille 1. Florian Thauvin (Lens) header from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Florian Sotoca with a cross.
Substitution, Lens. Mezian Mesloub replaces Thorgan Hazard.
Substitution, Lens. Michaël Cuisance replaces Amadou Haidara.
Substitution, Marseille. Keyliane Abdallah replaces Amine Harit.
Substitution, Marseille. Angel Gomes replaces Himad Abdelli.
Yacine Titraoui (Lens) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Amine Gouiri (Marseille) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Lens 1, Marseille 2. Keyliane Abdallah (Marseille) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Lens. Ruben Aguilar replaces Jonathan Gradit.
Substitution, Lens. Junior Kadile replaces Florian Sotoca.
Substitution, Lens. Michal Skóras replaces Saud Abdulhamid.
Substitution, Marseille. Geoffrey Kondogbia replaces Tochukwu Nnadi.
Jeffrey de Lange (Marseille) is shown the yellow card.
